# MDHI — Modern Heavy Industries (Taicang) Co., Ltd.

> MDHI is a structural steel fabricator in Taicang, Jiangsu, China, and a company of Modern Group. MDHI fabricates structural steel for buildings, power, HRSG support, mining, and industrial projects for international EPC contractors, steelwork partners, and project owners.

## Company
- Legal name: Modern Heavy Industries (Taicang) Co., Ltd. (MDHI)
- Short name: Modern Heavy Industries
- Address: 169 Longjiang Road, Taicang Port Development Zone, Taicang, Jiangsu, China
- Email: info@mdhiglobal.com
- Website: https://mdhiglobal.com/index.html
- Group: Modern Group — https://www.modernhig.com/
- Factory site: 100,000+ m2 in Taicang, near Taicang Port and Shanghai

## Products
- Structural steel: industrial buildings, process structures, heavy columns and beams, platework, material handling systems, and preassembled modules.
- Project sectors: power and utilities, buildings and infrastructure, mining and metals, oil, gas and chemicals, and industrial manufacturing.
